_comment: Everything project-specific for the .claude workflow lives here. Fill it in when you copy this template into a project. Hooks, skills and scripts read it; nothing else should hard-code these values. project_name: leave null to use the git repo name (from the git.remote URL, else the git folder name); set a string only to override it. app.base_url is the local site and app.deployed_url the deployed one (null if there is none; a list if there are several): the request log links to both at the top of its pages. app.local_urls lists any other localhost:port addresses the project serves (an API, a second app); the projects directory shows them all.

preview.instructions: How to verify the deployed build after a push, e.g. 'wait for the Vercel preview on the PR and open it', or the Base44 steps in .claude/skills/task-done/SKILL.md. Leave enabled=false if there is no hosted preview.

template._comment: Where this .claude/ folder came from. The update-template skill (/update-template) pulls newer versions from repo and branch. project_owned lists files that hold this project's own settings: the update never overwrites them (project.json only gets keys the template added).

metrics._comment: Tokens come from Claude Code's transcripts for each request's time window. Cost is shown only when pricing lists every model used, in USD per million tokens: {"<model id>": {"input": 0, "output": 0, "cache_write": 0, "cache_read": 0}}.

headless_narrative._comment: Opt-in. When enabled, an async Stop hook (headless-narrative.sh) starts a separate claude -p run that drafts the Execution summary and Errors sections from <slug>/checks/*.txt. Each run spends tokens.
